main.description: Report the group's pending ownership transfer, if any. Visible only to the current owner and the proposed new owner — other members are not told a transfer is in flight. Returns pending=false when there is no live proposal (never proposed, already resolved, or expired).

repo.description: The handle or DID of the target group. Optional during the #27 deprecation window: omit it and the group is taken from the (deprecated) JWT aud claim instead.

pending.description: True when a live pending transfer exists.
